text: I have lived, worked, and owned in Santee since 1994. I was first elected to the Santee City Council in 2010 and am proud to continue serving our residents and businesses. In 2007, I was named the Santee Citizen of the year, received a Small Business of the Year award, and in 2010 the “Five-Star Mortgage Professional” award by San Diego Magazine. I have also served as San Diego Association of Mortgage Brokers, East San Diego County Association of Realtors, and Santee Chamber of Commerce President. As a local business owner, I have had to navigate regulations and local ordinances. As a City Councilmember, I’ve used that experience to create and pass policies that support business establishment and growth. I have consistently partnered with the Chamber of Commerce to push for shopping and supporting local businesses while helping host events like summer concerts and festivals. I will continue to work closely with our businesses, support public safety, and improve our parks and roadways so your family and business can grow with our city. Our city staff know my motto is: “Find ways to say yes, not reasons to say no,” to the people and businesses we serve.
